glosses.notes: A common everyday way to refer to an old woman or elderly lady.

examples.sentence: 那位老太太虽然年纪已经很大了，但是每天早上还是会先把家里和门口都整理好，然后才慢慢出去买菜。
车一到站，那位老太太没有马上往前挤，而是先等后面抱着孩子的人都下去以后，自己才扶着门慢慢走。
楼里那位老太太平时话不多，可是谁家孩子晚上回来得太晚，她第二天见到家长时还是会认真提醒一句。

example_translations.translation: Although that old lady is already quite advanced in age, every morning she still first tidies up the house and the doorway before slowly going out to buy vegetables.

When the bus arrived, that old lady did not squeeze forward at once. Instead, she first waited until the people behind her carrying children had all gotten off, and only then did she slowly walk out holding the door.
The old lady in the building does not usually say much, but if someone’s child comes home too late at night, she will still seriously remind the parents the next day when she sees them.

glosses.notes: Used for being glad or willing to do something, often in a positive or generous way.

examples.sentence: 他虽然平时不太爱说话，但是只要别人真的有困难，他总是比谁都更乐于先停下来帮一下。
这位老师最让家长放心的地方，不是讲得多快，而是她一直乐于听孩子把真正的问题慢慢说完。
公司后来选他来带新人，不是因为他最会开会，而是因为他一直乐于把自己试过的办法分享给大家。

example_translations.translation: Although he does not usually like talking much, as long as someone truly has a difficulty, he is always more willing than anyone else to stop first and help a little.
What makes this teacher most reassuring to parents is not how fast she explains things, but that she is always willing to listen while a child slowly finishes saying what the real problem is.
The company later chose him to guide new workers not because he was the best at meetings, but because he was always willing to share the methods he had tried himself with everyone.

glosses.notes: The sound or phenomenon of thunder during a storm.

examples.sentence: 外面的雷刚响了两次，母亲就先去把阳台上的衣服拿回来，怕一会儿雨突然大起来，谁都来不及再出去。
孩子小时候一听见雷就不敢一个人睡，但是后来父亲每次都先陪他说一会儿话，他才慢慢没有那么怕了。
山里的天气变得很快，刚才还是大太阳，结果没过多久天上就开始有雷，大家只好先往回走。

example_translations.translation: As soon as the thunder outside had sounded twice, Mother went first to bring the clothes in from the balcony, afraid that if the rain suddenly grew heavier in a moment, no one would have time to go back out.

When the child was little, as soon as he heard thunder he did not dare sleep alone, but later Father would always first sit with him and talk for a while, and only then did he gradually stop being so afraid.
The weather in the mountains changed very quickly. Just a moment ago there was still strong sun, but before long there began to be thunder in the sky, so everyone had to head back first.

glosses.notes: A kind or classification that groups similar things together.

examples.sentence: 图书馆后来把这些旧书重新分了类别，这样孩子们下次再来找资料的时候，就不用像以前那样一排一排地看了。
老师让我们先想清楚这几个问题到底是不是同一类别，不然看上去都差不多，写出来却很容易乱。
医院整理表格的时候发现，原来有些信息一直放错了类别，所以后来大家又花了不少时间重新检查。

example_translations.translation: The library later regrouped these old books by category, so when the children came next time to look for materials, they no longer had to examine them row by row the way they used to.

The teacher told us to think clearly first about whether these questions really belonged to the same category. Otherwise they may all look similar, but once written out they become very easy to mix up.
While organizing the forms, the hospital discovered that some information had long been placed in the wrong category, so later everyone spent quite a bit of time checking everything again.

glosses.notes: Can mean reason or logic, and can also mean paying attention to someone or dealing with something.

examples.sentence: 你先别急着和他争，等把整件事再想一遍，就会知道这次到底是谁更有理。
他那天心里很乱，谁和他说话都不太想理，可是晚上一个人安静下来以后，又觉得自己不该把气放到别人身上。
经理让大家先别理外面的声音，把手里的数据检查完再说，不然一会儿开会的时候谁都说不清原因。

example_translations.translation: Don’t rush to argue with him. Once you think the whole matter through again, you will know whose side truly has more reason this time.

That day his mind was in chaos, and he did not really want to pay attention no matter who spoke to him, but after calming down alone that night, he felt he should not have taken his anger out on others.

The manager told everyone not to bother with the sounds outside for now and to finish checking the data in hand first, otherwise when the meeting started in a moment no one would be able to explain the reason clearly.

glosses.notes: To plan and manage money in a thoughtful way, not just to save or spend it.

examples.sentence: 父亲年轻的时候只知道把钱放着，后来家里事情多了，他才慢慢明白，理财不是只看眼前，而是把后面的事安排得更好。
银行那位经理说，很多人一开始以为理财就是买这个买那个，但是真正难的是先知道自己到底想解决什么问题。
她每个月发了工资都会先把要用的钱分出来，因为她觉得理财这件事越早想清楚，后面越不容易乱。

example_translations.translation: When Father was young, he only knew to leave money sitting there. Later, once family matters increased, he slowly came to understand that managing money is not about looking only at the present, but about arranging what comes later better.
That bank manager said many people at first think managing money just means buying this and buying that, but what is truly hard is first knowing what problem you actually want to solve.

Every month after getting paid, she first separates out the money she will need, because she feels that the earlier one thinks through money management, the less likely things are to fall into disorder later.

glosses.notes: Refers to the science side of study, such as math and science subjects.

examples.sentence: 孩子原来一直觉得自己不适合理科，但是后来听一位老师慢慢讲过以后，才发现很多题并没有想的那么可怕。
学校开家长会的时候，老师提醒大家别太早替孩子定理科还是文科，因为年纪再大一点，想法往往还会变。
她虽然学的是理科，但是写报告的时候一直很注意别人能不能一下看明白，所以组里的人都很爱和她一起做项目。

example_translations.translation: The child had originally always felt unsuited to the science track, but after later listening to one teacher explain it slowly, he discovered that many problems were not actually as frightening as he had imagined.

When the school held the parents’ meeting, the teacher reminded everyone not to decide too early whether a child should go into science or humanities, because once they grow a little older, their ideas often still change.

Although she studied science, when writing reports she always paid close attention to whether other people could immediately understand them, so the people in her group all liked working on projects with her.

glosses.notes: A guiding idea or way of thinking behind how someone works or makes decisions.

examples.sentence: 这家店开的时间虽然不算太久，但是它一直坚持自己的理念，所以来的客人不一定最多，留下来的人却很稳定。
负责人后来和大家说，这次改变不是突然想到的，而是原来的理念已经和现在的情况慢慢对不上了。
父亲看完那篇文章以后一直没有说话，因为里面提到的教育理念，和他年轻时相信的很多地方都不一样。

example_translations.translation: Although this shop has not been open for especially long, it has always kept to its own guiding idea, so the number of customers who come may not be the highest, but the people who stay are quite steady.
Later the person in charge told everyone that this change was not something suddenly thought of, but rather that the earlier guiding idea had already slowly stopped matching the present situation.
Father stayed silent for a long time after reading that article, because the educational ideas mentioned in it were very different from many of the things he had believed when he was young.

glosses.notes: Describes thinking calmly and reasonably rather than reacting only with emotion.

examples.sentence: 医生先让家里人都冷静一点，因为只有先把情况看得更理性，后面做出来的决定才不容易让人后悔。
她原来一听到别人不同意就会马上难过，但是后来经历的事多了，处理问题也比以前理性多了。
经理没有因为一时的消息就改变计划，而是等数据都出来以后，才用更理性的办法和大家重新讨论。

example_translations.translation: The doctor first asked the family members to calm down a little, because only by viewing the situation more rationally first could the decisions made afterward be less likely to cause regret.
She used to become upset as soon as someone disagreed with her, but after later going through more experiences, she handled problems much more rationally than before.
The manager did not change the plan because of a momentary bit of news. Instead, only after all the data came out did he discuss things again with everyone in a more rational way.

glosses.notes: Can mean to stand upright, or to establish something like a rule or goal.

examples.sentence: 工作人员把那块新牌子立在门口以后，第一次来的人终于不用站在外面反复看地图了。
父亲常说，家里再忙也要先立一个大家都能接受的规矩，不然小事一多，谁都会觉得自己有理。
她刚要坐下，老师就让她先立起来，把刚才那段话再慢慢读一遍，因为后面的人没有听清。

example_translations.translation: After the staff set that new sign upright at the entrance, people coming for the first time finally no longer had to stand outside repeatedly looking at the map.

Father often says that no matter how busy the family gets, they still need to establish a rule that everyone can accept first. Otherwise, once many small matters pile up, everyone will feel that they are in the right.
Just as she was about to sit down, the teacher told her to stand back up first and slowly read that passage again, because the people in the back had not heard it clearly.

glosses.notes: Used for a grain or small piece, and also as a measure word for tiny round things like pills.

examples.sentence: 母亲把最后一粒米捡起来给孩子看，说家里东西再多，也不能因为看着小就随便浪费。
医生让他按时吃药，还特别提醒他这次一次只吃一粒，不要因为着急想快一点好就自己加。
母亲把盘子里的花生一粒一粒地分给两个孩子，怕一个拿得太快，另一个心里又不高兴。

example_translations.translation: Mother picked up the last grain of rice and showed it to the child, saying that no matter how many things there are at home, you still cannot waste something casually just because it looks small.

The doctor told him to take his medicine on time and especially reminded him that this time he should take only one pill at a time and not add more himself just because he wanted to get better faster.
Mother divided the peanuts on the plate between the two children one by one, afraid that if one took them too quickly, the other would start feeling unhappy.

glosses.notes: The point of view or side from which someone looks at an issue.

examples.sentence: 开会的时候大家意见都很多，但是负责人还是提醒我们，先把自己的立场说清楚，再谈后面的办法，事情才不会越说越乱。
父亲原来一直站在自己的立场看这件事，后来听完孩子那边的想法，才知道自己前面有些话说得太快了。
她写报告的时候最难的，不是把材料都放进去，而是要在不同立场之间找到一种大家都能接受的说法。

example_translations.translation: During the meeting everyone had many opinions, but the person in charge still reminded us to explain our own standpoint clearly first and only then discuss what to do next, so that the matter would not become more chaotic the more it was discussed.

Father had originally always looked at this matter from his own standpoint. Only after hearing the child’s side of the thinking did he realize that some of the things he had said earlier were too hasty.
What was hardest for her while writing the report was not putting all the materials in, but finding a way of expressing things that people from different standpoints could all accept.

glosses.notes: The strength or force with which something is carried out.

examples.meaning_en: intensity of an inspection or effort
examples.sentence: 这次检查的力度比以前大得多，所以很多原来一直拖着不改的问题，后来都被要求按时处理完。
医生说，他这几天先别用太大力度活动那只手，不然刚好一点的地方又会重新疼起来。
公司后来加大了对安全问题的力度，不是因为外面有人批评，而是因为前一段确实出了几次不该出的错。

example_translations.translation: The intensity of this inspection was much greater than before, so many problems that had originally been dragged out without correction were later all required to be handled on time.
The doctor said that for the next few days he should not move that hand with too much force, otherwise the place that had just gotten a little better would start hurting again.

The company later increased the intensity of its work on safety issues, not because someone outside criticized it, but because in the earlier period there had indeed been several mistakes that should not have happened.

glosses.notes: To pass through or experience a long process, period, or series of events.

examples.sentence: 这座老房子历经这么多年还能一直站在这里，不只是因为材料好，也是因为后来每次下雨以前都有人先来检查。
父亲说，那位老师之所以讲话总能让人安静下来，是因为他真的历经过很多事，知道什么话该先说，什么话可以晚一点再说。
这个项目从开始到现在历经了好几次改变，但是大家一直没有放弃，所以最后还是慢慢看见了结果。

example_translations.translation: The fact that this old house could still stand here after going through so many years was not only because the materials were good, but also because later, before every rainfall, someone always came first to inspect it.

Father said that the reason that teacher could always make people quiet down when he spoke was that he had truly gone through many things and knew which words should be said first and which could wait until later.
From the beginning until now, this project has gone through several changes, but everyone has kept refusing to give up, so in the end they still slowly saw results.

glosses.notes: Refers to something across many past years.

examples.sentence: 学校把这门课的历年题目都整理出来以后，孩子才发现自己原来一直怕的那一类问题，其实每年都会换一种问法。
父亲看历年照片的时候最容易安静下来，因为很多早就以为记不清的人和地方，又会一下回到眼前。
经理比较了历年数据以后才决定怎么改计划，因为今年看上去特别的地方，往前看并不一定真的没有出现过。

example_translations.translation: After the school organized all the past-year questions for this course, the child realized that the type of problem he had always feared was actually asked in a different way each year.
When Father looks through photos from past years, he most easily grows quiet, because people and places he had long thought he no longer remembered suddenly come back before his eyes.

Only after comparing data from past years did the manager decide how to change the plan, because what looked special this year did not necessarily mean it had never appeared before if you looked back further.

glosses.notes: Something or someone that does not follow the usual rule or pattern.

examples.sentence: 这家店平时晚上十点就关门，但是昨天因为外面一直下大雨，老板才第一次例外多等了半个小时。
医生说，按时吃药这件事没有谁可以例外，因为前面几天要是乱了，后面就更不容易稳定下来。
父亲原来以为她这次也会生气，但是没想到她反而成了例外，听完以后只是先安静地笑了一下。

example_translations.translation: This shop normally closes at ten every night, but yesterday, because heavy rain kept falling outside, the boss made an exception for the first time and waited an extra half hour.
The doctor said that in the matter of taking medicine on time, no one can be an exception, because if the first few days become disordered, it will be even harder for things to stabilize later.
Father had originally thought she would be angry this time too, but unexpectedly she became the exception instead; after listening, she merely gave a quiet little smile first.

glosses.notes: The money earned or paid because money is saved, borrowed, or deposited over time.

examples.sentence: 银行那位经理把这次存款的利息算给父亲看以后，他才明白，原来时间长一点和短一点，最后差得真的不少。
她以前只看每个月要还多少钱，后来认真问过利息怎么算，才知道自己前面做的决定其实太着急了。
老板说，这笔钱如果一直放在那里不动，利息虽然会慢慢增加，但是真正要解决的问题还是没有变。

example_translations.translation: After the bank manager calculated the interest on this deposit for Father, he finally understood that a longer time and a shorter time really did make quite a large difference in the end.

She used to look only at how much she had to pay back each month. Only after seriously asking how the interest was calculated did she realize that the decision she had made earlier had really been too hasty.
The boss said that if this sum of money were left there without being touched, the interest would slowly increase, but the real problem that needed solving still would not have changed.

glosses.notes: The international organization made up of many member countries.

examples.sentence: 老师让我们先看一段关于联合国的介绍，再讨论为什么有些国家明明意见不同，还是要继续坐下来谈。

examples.meaning_en: the name United Nations in the news
examples.sentence: 孩子第一次在新闻里听见联合国这个名字的时候，只记得很多人一直坐在一起开会，后来才慢慢明白它到底管什么。

examples.meaning_en: United Nations as an organization for coordination
examples.sentence: 父亲看完那本书以后说，很多人一提联合国就只想到会议，但是最难的地方，是让意见差得很大的人一直保持联系。

example_translations.translation: The teacher told us first to watch an introduction about the United Nations and then discuss why some countries, even though their opinions clearly differ, still have to keep sitting down to talk.

The first time the child heard the name United Nations in the news, all he remembered was that many people kept sitting together in meetings. Only later did he slowly understand what it actually manages.

After reading that book, Father said that when many people mention the United Nations, they think only of meetings, but the truly hard part is keeping people with sharply different views in contact over time.

glosses.notes: To connect a machine or system to a network so information can be shared.

examples.sentence: 这台机器一联网，原来只能在一个房间里看的数据，后来在别的地方也能同时打开，所以大家做事方便了很多。
医院那边一联网以后，医生看资料就不用再一层一层地跑过去问人，所以很多检查比以前快了不少。
父亲原来怕这些老设备不能联网，但是工作人员试了几次以后发现，只要把前面的设置改一下，问题就不大了。

example_translations.translation: Once this machine was connected to the network, data that originally could be viewed only in one room could later also be opened at the same time in other places, so everyone’s work became much more convenient.
Once the hospital’s side was networked, doctors no longer had to keep running floor by floor to ask people for materials, so many checks became quite a bit faster than before.

Father had originally worried that these old devices could not connect to a network, but after the staff tried a few times, they discovered that as long as the earlier settings were changed a little, the problem was not very big.

glosses.notes: To connect one thing in your mind with another because they remind you of each other.

examples.sentence: 孩子一看见那张旧照片，就联想到小时候和外公一起出门的那一天，所以坐在那里很久都没有说话。
老师说，读文章的时候先有一点联想不是坏事，但是如果联想得太远，就容易把作者真正想说的话看成别的意思。
她一闻到厨房里那个味道，就会联想到很多年前住在老房子里的时候，所以每次都先笑一下再进去。

example_translations.translation: As soon as the child saw that old photo, he associated it with the day when he had gone out with his grandfather as a child, so he sat there for a long time without speaking.

The teacher said that having a little association first while reading an article is not a bad thing, but if your associations go too far, it becomes easy to take what the author truly wanted to say as some other meaning.
As soon as she smelled that smell in the kitchen, she would associate it with the years long ago when she lived in the old house, so every time she first smiled before going in.

glosses.notes: To connect parts, ideas, or systems so that they work together or refer to each other.

examples.sentence: 编辑那篇文章的时候，经理让他把前后两段再链接得更清楚一点，不然第一次看的人很难马上明白中间怎么转。
系统后来把医院和银行的数据先链接到一起，所以工作人员不用再拿着同一张表来回跑很多次。

examples.meaning_en: link new problems with old experience
examples.sentence: 老师常说，真正难的不是记住很多知识，而是把新问题和旧经验链接起来，然后知道下一步该怎么做。

example_translations.translation: While editing that article, the manager told him to link the front and back sections more clearly, otherwise people seeing it for the first time would have a hard time immediately understanding how the middle part turned.
The system later linked the hospital’s and the bank’s data together first, so the staff no longer had to carry the same form back and forth many times.
The teacher often says that the truly hard thing is not remembering a lot of knowledge, but linking new problems with old experience and then knowing what the next step should be.

glosses.notes: Literally both banks or sides, often of a river, strait, or other dividing line.

examples.sentence: 春天一到，这条河两岸的树就一起变绿，所以很多人下班以后都爱沿着那条路慢慢走一会儿。
父亲年轻时常坐船来往两岸，所以后来再看这座桥的时候，总觉得眼前的地方已经和以前很不一样了。
老师指着地图说，这个城市真正特别的地方，不只是水从中间过去，而是两岸的人一直用不同办法把日子过下去。

example_translations.translation: As soon as spring arrives, the trees on both sides of this river turn green together, so many people like to walk slowly along that road for a while after getting off work.

When Father was young, he often took boats back and forth between the two sides, so later whenever he looked at this bridge again, he always felt the place before his eyes had already become very different from before.

Pointing at the map, the teacher said that what was truly special about this city was not only that water passed through the middle, but that the people on both sides had long used different methods to keep life going.

glosses.notes: Can refer to the Earth’s two poles, or more generally to two extreme ends.

examples.sentence: 老师指着地图说，两极虽然离我们很远，但是那边温度和海的变化，后来还是会一点一点影响到这里。

examples.meaning_en: the polar regions in a film
examples.sentence: 孩子第一次看见关于两极的纪录片时，最先记住的不是白色的雪，而是那里安静得连人的声音都很少。
很多讨论一开始还很平和，但是一有人只肯站在两极看问题，后面就越来越难把真正的原因说清楚了。

example_translations.translation: Pointing at the map, the teacher said that although the two poles are far from us, changes in temperature and the sea over there still gradually affect this place later on.
When the child first saw a documentary about the two poles, what he remembered first was not the white snow, but a place so quiet that even human voices were very rare.
Many discussions begin calmly enough, but once someone insists on looking at the issue only from two extremes, it becomes harder and harder afterward to explain the real reasons clearly.

glosses.notes: Can mean letting something dry in the air, or leaving someone waiting without attending to them.

examples.sentence: 母亲看见太阳出来以后，就把刚洗好的衣服都拿到阳台上去晾，怕晚上再下雨的时候家里没有地方放。
这碗汤太热，医生让他先晾一会儿再喝，不然嘴里本来刚好的地方又会被烫到。
父亲常说，事情再急也别把客人晾在门口太久，所以每次一听见有人来，他都会先放下手里的活。

example_translations.translation: After seeing that the sun had come out, Mother took all the clothes that had just been washed to the balcony to air-dry, afraid that if it rained again at night there would be nowhere at home to put them.
This bowl of soup was too hot, so the doctor told him to let it sit and cool for a while before drinking it, otherwise the part in his mouth that had just healed would get burned again.
Father often says that no matter how urgent things are, you should not leave guests waiting at the door too long, so every time he hears someone arrive, he first puts down the work in his hands.

glosses.notes: This row teaches the noun sense of 料, often meaning material, stuff, or ingredient depending on context.

examples.sentence: 这道菜看着不复杂，但是真正难的是把前面的料先准备好，不然一到锅里，顺序一乱味道就全变了。
老人摸了摸那件衣服的料，马上就知道它为什么穿起来很轻，但是天气一变又不太挡风。
父亲把修门要用的料都先放到旁边，但是真正开始做的时候还是发现，少了一样小东西，前面做好的安排又得重新来一次。

example_translations.translation: This dish does not look complicated, but what is truly hard is getting all the ingredients ready first. Otherwise, once they go into the wok and the order gets mixed up, the taste changes completely.
The old man touched the material of that piece of clothing and immediately understood why it felt very light when worn, yet stopped the wind poorly once the weather changed.

Father first put all the materials needed for repairing the door beside him, but when he truly started working, he still discovered that one small thing was missing, so the earlier arrangement had to be done again.
